role: Agent 5, cross-review round 3: evidence and regression credibility for the whole register. Read-only on every repository; scratch C:\Users\stephen\AppData\Local\Temp\hw-r3x-adversarial; lab ports 31910..31912; frozen baseline served through PI_SIM_PLUGIN_DIR (token 1.7.0.0-d03); headless Chrome on Windows, simulated host, sample data. Nothing here is real-host evidence. All my Chrome processes on port 31912 were stopped (0 left; cdp.mjs close() leaked 24 of them on Windows, see new concerns). Labels: MEASURED (I ran it), READ (code or files), INFERRED (judgment).

verdicts.rationale: The defect is solid: P01 and X02 MEASURED it with trusted CDP input, and the cause is READ. The capture listener (pi-common.js:2961-2966) runs seedFromElite, whose promise chain ends in hw.resyncBound() (2943). That resets #f-preset to the stored 'elite' before the shell's own change listener saves the pick. A microtask checkpoint between listeners happens only for UA-dispatched events, so the same fault applies to Chrome 130 in the host (INFERRED, high). The weak part is the wording of the fix. 'Seed only after the preset write lands' can be built as 'wait for the plugin's answer'. The simulator answers every setSettings with a preview 5 ms later (READ pi-sim.mjs setSettings case), but the real host sends the panel no settings echo. A seed gated on an answer would be tuned to simulator timing.
verdicts.regression_risk: A seed gated on an echo or preview never runs, or runs late, on the real host. Resyncing #f-preset in any form brings the snap-back back. A deferred seed can race a replaced configuration document. A Custom frame that lands before its seeds leaves Legacy fallbacks behind if the panel is torn down in between.
verdicts.revised_correction: Capture the intent in the capture phase. Never resync #f-preset; resync only the six gesture selects. Run the seed within the same user event, after the shell's target listener (for example setTimeout 0 scheduled from the capture listener), and never from an echo. Write order must leave a safe state: either one frame that carries controlPreset 'custom' plus the six seeded gestures, or the seeds first and the 'custom' frame last. Seeds stored under Elite change nothing the dial does.
verdicts.acceptance_test: Battery B1. dial-groups at 373x410, DPR 1.5, Controls open, three trusted paths: typeahead 'c', ArrowDown, and a CDP mouse press on the select followed by ArrowDown and Enter. Each must end with 'custom' stored and shown, #controls-custom visible and the six gestures equal to the Elite map. The last frame carries 'custom', and no frame after the first 'custom' frame carries 'elite'. dial-custom-gestures, ArrowUp then ArrowDown: ends on 'custom' with gestureTap 'pin' kept. dial-configured, Legacy to Custom: exactly 1 frame and no gesture field. An echo that switches Elite to Custom: 0 frames. Mutation: put #f-preset back into the resync and path 1 must fail. Host (owner): pick Custom by mouse on an Elite dial, reselect the dial, Custom is still shown.
verdicts.evidence: MEASURED by P01 (p6-preset.json, p6b log order, p6c) and X02. READ pi-common.js:2917-2968, pi-shell.js:209-244, scripts/lib/pi-sim.mjs (setSettings answered by setTimeout(pushPreview, 5); no didReceiveSettings echo). READ live e2e-pi-panels.mjs:233-253 (at the time read): trusted ArrowDown is already used, but it asserts writes >= 2, not order or count.

verdicts.rationale: Reproduced defect (V01 and P02 MEASURED; B02's 'x reads as clear field' is only a walkthrough hypothesis). Reusing the Replace idiom literally does not fix the gesture that was reproduced. Replace confirms on any second press within 5 s (READ pi-common.js:4247-4248) and has no dwell or click-count guard. A real double click would arm the clicked group and then remove it before the person sees the question, which fails V01's own test (a double click writes 0). The live e2e (READ, not run) now asserts that a 60 ms double press only arms, so the working tree has a dwell; that dwell must become the stated contract. R02 also drops P02's Merge finding. Merge sits 6 px from Add group and drops every group name in one press, and Split afterwards gives unnamed groups (MEASURED P02 p3 G4, p7 e).
verdicts.regression_risk: The armed words widen the group head. At 189 and 160 px they can wrap and move the control out from under the pointer. An arm that survives a rebuild can fire on a later stray click. Separate arm helpers for R02 and R09 will drift apart. Suites that remove a group in one click need a second press.
verdicts.revised_correction: Use one arm helper for Replace, group remove and Merge. The first press arms and says so in words. A second press counts only after a 500 ms dwell, which ignores a click with event.detail >= 2 and a double Enter. The arm clears on blur, on rebuild and on any other edit, with a polite announcement. After a removal, focus goes to a non-destructive control, and the element under the pointer is neither a remove nor Merge. Merge arms whenever any group is named or two or more groups hold readings.
verdicts.acceptance_test: Battery B2. dial-groups plus Add group, at 373x410 DPR 1.5 and at 189x410. (a) CDP double click on group 1's remove (press and release with clickCount 1, then clickCount 2, 120 ms apart): 0 frames, armed words visible. (b) Enter twice, 120 ms apart, on the focused remove: 0 frames. (c) Press, wait 700 ms, press: exactly 1 frame and only group 1 gone. activeElement is neither .hw-group-remove nor BODY, and elementFromPoint at the press point is neither a remove nor Merge. (d) Arm, then Tab away: disarmed, 0 frames. (e) One press on Merge with a named group: 0 frames, names intact. (f) At 189, elementFromPoint at the press point is still the armed control after arming.
verdicts.evidence: MEASURED V01 (p5 group-remove-twice.json) and P02 (p3 G3, G4; p7 d, e). READ pi-common.js:3980-3995 and 4228-4262. READ live e2e-pi-panels.mjs:566-588.

verdicts.rationale: Reproduced in the simulator (X07 and P08 MEASURED). The host half is a walkthrough hypothesis, but the fix reuses the leave flush the shell already runs for bound fields, and that flush rests on bench evidence (READ pi-shell.js:124-130: 20 of 20 quick Label edits were lost before it existed). With no new mechanism, the fix is exactly as credible on the host as the existing flush, which is the right bar.
verdicts.regression_risk: A commit on leave could rebuild the rotation editor under the caret (the guard at pi-common.js:676 protects only .hw-group-name). Writing an unchanged or empty value could clear a custom name. An IME commit could land mid-composition.
verdicts.revised_correction: As disposed, plus three rules: write only when the value differs from the stored one, never rebuild the editor as a result of the flush, and honor the shell's composing guard.

Type 'Zzq' without Enter, then dispatch mouseleave on documentElement and a window blur: exactly 1 frame per field containing the text, and the same input node keeps focus with the caret at the end. Unchanged value plus leave: 0 frames. compositionstart, typing and leave: 0 frames, then compositionend: 1 frame. Host (integrator): 10 trials per field of typing, clicking another key within 200 ms and reselecting: 10 of 10 names stored.

verdicts.rationale: Reproduced defect (B01, A04). The fix's counting rule is under-specified. The runtime skips keys the snapshot lacks, and it also collapses a linked pair to one entry (READ src/rotation.ts:16-26 pickedReadings). Counting 'live members' with keyIsMissing alone would still overcount linked pairs. Grouped mode has the same fault: populated counts a group whose members are all missing (READ pi-common.js:719). The pill needs the existing treeHasSnapshot guard (READ pi-common.js:118-119), or an unavailable source would accuse every chip. At 160 px the existing 'on dial' pill is already cut (A09), so a second pill needs flex:none.
verdicts.regression_risk: Wider chips. Two pills on a chip that is both current and missing. The count changes when a sensor sleeps, and the note speaks on the 'rotation' live channel, so dropouts may be announced. Screen readers hear the phrase twice unless the sr-only span goes.
verdicts.revised_correction: Show a visible 'not in HWiNFO' pill (flex:none) on rotation and detail chips and drop the sr-only duplicate. The note's number must come from the runtime's own rule (the same skip and link dedupe as rotationReadings). The grouped-mode note must count groups by their live members. No pill and no 'skipped' claim unless the tree has a snapshot.
verdicts.acceptance_test: Battery B5. Cases: dial-configured with rotationKeys [gpu, 'f0099999:0:1000000', hot]; the same list with a linked duplicate pair; dial-groups with group 2 holding only a missing key; dial-unavailable with the same keys; key-details with one missing detail key. Viewports 373x410 and 160x410, plus emulated forced colors at 373. Pass: the pill is visible and unclipped in innerText (sr-only excluded) at 373, at 160 and in forced colors. The phrase occurs exactly once in the AX name. The note's number equals rotationReadings(keys, current, snapshot).length, computed by importing src/rotation.ts in the probe. The groups note agrees with the runtime. dial-unavailable shows no pill and no skip claim. Opening writes 0.
verdicts.evidence: MEASURED B01 (probe2 P2) and A04 (ax.mjs). READ src/rotation.ts:16-50, pi-common.js:118-119, 410-448 and 715-729.

verdicts.rationale: Three problems. (1) Evidence: every measurement came from headless Chrome at emulated widths. No reviewer checked that the Stream Deck app can zoom its panel at all (a11y lists it under not_run), and WCAG 1.4.10 is defined at 320 CSS px, where the panel already reflows. S3 rests on that unverified assumption. Keep FIX because the change is scoped CSS, but mark it lab-only until the owner confirms Ctrl+wheel or Ctrl+= zoom. (2) The merge dropped X03's layout-shift defect, and the disposed correction ('the slot and hint may wrap') does not fix it. MEASURED on dial-groups (pb-slot.mjs): selecting in group 1 moves group 2 by 32 px at 310, 298, 280, 249, 240 and 189 px, and by 96 px at 160. After a real press on group 2's first member, the pointer rests on '← Earlier' (310 to 280) or '→ Later' (160). With A09's wrap CSS the shift is 32, 4 and 68 px (240, 189, 160); with V07's ellipsis it is 32, 32 and 96 px. It is 0 px at 373 and 320. The no-shift promise therefore breaks below about 315 px, not only below 240. (3) A09's cut theme line at 160 px (the resolved name) is missing, and it is a contract 1 failure.
verdicts.regression_risk: An unscoped header wrap unpins the dial header at 252 to 270 px (A01 MEASURED). A wrapping theme line sits above the chips, so a pick moves the chips at zoom widths (MEASURED pd-zoomband: P0 with the wrap rule at 160 is 234 px for Default/Ultraviolet against 217 for Ember). Reserving the measured toolbar height makes each grouped list taller at narrow widths.
verdicts.revised_correction: Keep the header wrap scoped below 240 px, the face flex:none, and no breaks inside words. For the rotation slot at every width: min-width:0; the hint ellipsizes and never wraps; every slot reserves the toolbar's measured height (one ResizeObserver writing --hw-tools-h). The resolved theme name must stay whole at 160 without moving the chips on a pick (reserve the line's height, or show the resolved name below the chips at narrow widths).
verdicts.acceptance_test: Battery B6. Fixtures: key-configured, key-unavailable, dial-configured, dial-groups (default and all-open) and control-reset. Widths: 373 (DPR 1.5), 320, 310, 298, 240, 189 and 160, all at height 410. Pass: overflowX 0 everywhere. Header rectangles and pinned state at 373 and 320 identical to the frozen baseline (0 px difference). At 189 and 160 the kind line uses at most 2 lines with no break inside a word, and the dial face's visible share is 1.0. Key and dial chips end at or above 410 at 189 and 160 (baseline: key 406 and 649, dial 341 and 440). Shift test: select group 1's first option by CDP click, then press group 2's first option at its pre-press point. Group 2 moves 0 px, and elementFromPoint after the press is the pressed option at every width.
verdicts.evidence: MEASURED here: pb-slot.mjs and pb-slot2.mjs (dial-groups shift table), pd-zoomband.mjs, and density-373-189-160.json (dial-groups overflowX 58 at 189 and 87 at 160; key header 232 at 189 and 476 at 160). MEASURED A01 (injection verification), X03, X04, V07 and B03. READ pi.css:1380-1405.

verdicts.rationale: Reproduced defect (P03). The disposed suffix goes at the end of the chip text, and chips ellipsize at their 170 to 190 px cap. For long labels ('Drive Temperature' on two SSDs) the ellipsis cuts exactly the part that tells the two apart, so the screenshot looks fixed while the task still fails.
verdicts.regression_risk: Wider colliding chips wrap the row sooner at 320. A missing member cannot name its source (no tree entry).
verdicts.revised_correction: Put the distinguishing text where it cannot be ellipsized: a flex:none suffix pill (the 'on dial' style) or text before the label. Add it only to colliding chips. Titles and every accessible name (option, toolbar buttons, rename label, tile buttons) name the sensor.
verdicts.acceptance_test: dial-configured with rotationKeys [Drive #0, Drive #1, CPU] and key-details with drive0 and drive1, at 373x410 and 189x410. The distinguishing substring of each colliding chip lies wholly inside the chip's clip box (range test). The accessible names and titles of the two differ, and so do the toolbar names when each one is selected and the two remove buttons in the tile editor. Non-colliding chips are byte-identical to baseline.
verdicts.evidence: MEASURED P03 (p3 G7, p4 D4). READ pi.css chip max-width rules and pi-common.js:410-448. The ellipsis risk is INFERRED from the chip cap.

verdicts.rationale: The measured 96 px is the smallest case. statusSentence appends gadgetWithheldNotes whenever blockedReadingCount or contradictoryReadingCount is set (READ src/ui/state-screens.ts:87-95), and no first-pass fixture used those variants (V lists them under not_run). MEASURED with blockedReadingCount 2 and contradictoryReadingCount 1 at 373x410 DPR 1.5: the status box is 193 px. The key palette runs 317 to 387 and the key picker ends at 500 (off screen). The dial palette runs 333 to 403 and its picker ends at 516. The header already says 'Live · Gadget registry' (MEASURED), so the box is not needed to answer 'is it live'. A new disclosure in the status region moves complexity rather than removing it, and splitting the plugin's sentence in the panel would couple the panel to plugin copy.
verdicts.regression_risk: Hiding the withheld-reading remedy (untick or relabel one of two readings in HWiNFO) when a rotation member is the withheld one. Copy in state-screens.ts falls under the release copy rules and validator.
verdicts.revised_correction: For info tone, show one panel-owned line ('Gadget registry: current values only, no min, max or average.') and move the plugin's full hint, withheld notes included, into Advanced > Connection next to the existing Gadget setup text. No new disclosure widget in the status region. When a source is forced, its sentence replaces the generic hint rather than following it.
verdicts.acceptance_test: Battery B7 at 373x410 DPR 1.5. Cases: data 'gadget' with the plain sample snapshot, and with blockedReadingCount 2 and contradictoryReadingCount 1; key-configured and dial-configured each. Pass: status height <= 40 px, key palette top <= 150, dial palette top <= 166, key #picker-search bottom <= 410, 'no min' visible without a click. The withheld remedy is reachable in <= 2 activations with 0 writes. key-unavailable and dial-unavailable with globals.source 'gadget': no sentence advises enabling Shared Memory, and both chip rows end at or above 410. node scripts/validate-release-copy.mjs passes if plugin copy changed.

verdicts.rationale: Agreed as far as it goes, but it drops two of X02's five points. The zero/negative check claims more than it tests: it only reads the state line. The observe loop never hovers, so a regression like R04 passes. The register also says 'palette checks at 373 and 189' without defining 'in view under the header' at 189, where the header is not pinned. The live tree now asserts one frame for group removal and for reorders (READ e2e:588, 592), but line 137 still uses sim.writes.length >= 1 at the time read.

verdicts.revised_correction: Assert === 1 for every entry in the edit table, with an explicit exception list that states each count. The palette check runs at 373x410 (pinned: chips end at or above 410 under the header) and at 189x410 (unpinned: chips end at or above 410 at load). Add real CDP hover to the observe loop. The zero/negative check asserts the face text, or it is renamed.

Severity basis for every zoom-only S3 item (R06 and parts of R05 and R38): no reviewer verified that the Stream Deck app can zoom its property inspector. WCAG 1.4.10 is defined at 320 CSS px, where the panel already reflows. Ask the owner for one Ctrl+wheel or Ctrl+= check before treating these as S3 on the host.

Simulator timing leaks into fixes: pi-sim answers every setSettings with a preview after 5 ms and echoes didReceiveGlobalSettings on setGlobalSettings. Any fix that waits for 'the write to land' (R01) or reads state from an echo (R34) must not depend on that timing.

Density lab DPR: pi-lab density runs at DPR 1 while the host runs at 1.5. Wrap thresholds for the header, the band line and the toolbar can differ, so spot-check the 373 header and band heights at DPR 1.5 in the final battery.

Lab hygiene threatens the battery itself: on Windows, scripts/lib/cdp.mjs close() leaves Chrome running on the debug port. Here, 24 processes were left after 6 runs, and later runs attached to the stale browser. A reused page can carry emulation such as forced colors, reduced motion or viewport into an unrelated measurement. Before each battery run, kill that port's chrome.exe trees, and record window.__hwPiVersion in every row so a stale or wrong tree cannot pass.

Cross-item budget: R18, R19, R20 and R29 add lines to the dial's longest fieldset while R42 removes lines. R42's removal of the search help's second sentence leaves the slot hint, which R06 ellipsizes at zoom widths, as the only copy of the select-then-move instruction.
Sequencing: R04 before R38; R28 before R14; the arm helper shared by R02, R09 and Merge before R08's Tab test (Tab from a group name lands on a remove button).

Live e2e R04 check (e2e-pi-panels.mjs:460-470, read at review time) hovers 3 of 8 chips and uses programmatic focus() on a tabindex=-1 chip. It misses the unknown-stored-theme Tab path where X01 reproduced the wrong resolved theme.

BATTERY B0 (run on the frozen copy and on the final tree, one lab at a time, same Chrome). PI_SIM_PLUGIN_DIR is set per tree. Before and after each run, assert that no chrome.exe carries --remote-debugging-port=<base+2>. Record window.__hwPiVersion and sim write counts in every row.
